title: Census the position-name fold and generate the implicit-grant audit report (#13419 slice 1)
body:
Part of #13419

Slice 1 of the 2026-08-31 maintainer ruling (verbatim 「同意」): 执行要点 **1 (普查)** and **4 (隐式授予审计报告)**. Both are measurement and reporting. ⛔ No resolution behaviour changes here — not even a warning, because 要点 5 requires behaviour stay unchanged until the loud version ships.

The ruling's 执行要点 are 「顺序即依赖」, so 要点 2 (物化) and 3 (删折叠) are deliberately out of scope: 「⛔ 不物化不删折叠」, and 要点 3's landing file is held by an open draft. `security-plugin.ts` was read, never edited.

Authored in Claude Code session `session_016ZC5rNQj3WEet5HAmmAkMs` — https://claude.ai/code/session_016ZC5rNQj3WEet5HAmmAkMs

## What landed

One file: `scripts/measure-position-name-fold-census.mjs`. Not a gate — not wired into any workflow, not named `check:*`/`gen:*`, so the script ledger has nothing to classify (the shape `measure-durability-swallow-family.mjs` established).

## The premise, re-located by symbol

⚠️ The ruling cited `security-plugin.ts:4638`; line numbers rot and `main` moved several commits. Re-located by symbol — `requested = [...positions, ...explicitPermissionSets]` now sits at **:4657**, in `resolvePermissionSetsForContextUnmemoized`. Premise intact.

**PM assumption 1 (「同名折叠只有一处」) — falsified in the useful direction: still one fold, but it has a second, fold-*dependent* site the deletion must revisit.** `resolve-authz-context.ts` step 6a drops a deactivated position's NAME from `grants.positions` *specifically because* the name is re-resolved one layer down — that is the ruling's 「上游停用清扫的注释自证知情」, and it is code 要点 3 has to touch, not just a comment. No second fold on the resolution chain: `explain-engine` reports positions and set names separately, and `/auth/me/permissions` reaches the same single fold through `resolvePermissionSetsForContext`.

## The census, with its positive controls

The instrument **refuses to print any number until its controls pass** — the ruling asked for a census WITH positive controls, and a number from an instrument that has not just proven it fires is not a reading.

| control | required | result |
|---|---|---|
| `everyone` → `member_default` | classified JUNCTION, absent from name-dependencies | ✅ |
| HotCRM `sales_manager` | DETECTED as a name-dependency | ✅ |
| `contributor` → `showcase_contributor` | junction-bound, never a name-fold | ✅ |
| `finance_approver` → `crm_sales_user` (second binder, different app) | seen as junction-bound, not inert | ✅ |
| 8 parse-integrity anchors | built-in names present, or the scan has drifted | ✅ |
| 5 audit-generator controls | incl. empty-input NOT_MEASURED | ✅ |

The junction anchor is checked as *present in the junction output*, not merely absent from the fold list — the two names differ, so absence alone would pass for the wrong reason.

**Reading: 2 name-fold dependencies over in-repo declarations** — `sales_rep` and `sales_manager`, both `cross_scope` (position from `examples/app-crm`, permission set from the composed HotCRM artifact). 13 junction bindings; 7 inert positions that 要点 3's collision warning must not fire on.

⚠️ **The distinction 要点 2 turns on, now asserted:** `sales_manager` IS junction-bound — to `crm_sales_user` — and is *still* a name-fold, because the fold is about the pair (position N, set N). Materialising "some binding" for a position does not retire its fold; only binding N to the same-named set N does.

## Three bugs the controls caught, all kept red-able

1. **Binder scan keyed on one app's constant name.** It looked for `POSITION_PERMISSION_SET_BINDINGS` (app-showcase's spelling); app-crm calls the identical structure `BINDINGS`, so three real junction rows were invisible and `finance_approver` was reported INERT while bound (10 → 13 bindings, 8 → 7 inert). Under-collection on the junction side is how a census hands 要点 2 a worklist that deletes a live grant. Now anchored on the labelled tuple type and pinned by a second-binder control on a different app.
2. **`isDefault` window bleed.** A fixed 4000-char look-ahead reached `showcase_member_default`'s `isDefault: true` from `showcase_ops` ~90 lines earlier and invented two junction bindings nothing creates. Fixed with real brace matching; pinned by a regression control.
3. **Raw NUL bytes in the census's own key separators.** `check:nul-bytes` caught 4 × `0x00` where a separator was intended. Fixed; census and audit output byte-identical before and after.

## Reverse verification (predicted direction stated first)

- Delete the artifact's `sales_manager` set → control B fails and the census **refuses to print**, rather than printing a smaller number.
- Materialise `['sales_rep','sales_rep']` in an app binder → `sales_rep` moves out of `nameFolds` (2 → 1) into `junctionOnSameName`. **This is 要点 2's mechanism, verified before anyone writes it.**
- Hide app-crm's tuple type → the second-binder control goes red, naming both symptoms (missed binding, false inert).

Every mutation was confirmed on disk before its reading, and every restore proven byte-identical to the HEAD blob. One mutation attempt silently missed its anchor; the disk-landing guard voided the reading instead of reporting a green from an unmutated tree.

## 要点 4 — the audit report

`--audit FILE` turns a deployment export into the per-organization implicit-grant report; `--audit-schema` prints the shape plus the SQL for each table. Verified on a test rig: it names each implicit grant with its blast radius, correctly withholds a grant from a DEACTIVATED position (ADR-0049), and correctly does **not** report the junction-bound `everyone` pair.

**PM assumption 3 confirmed — and the boundary is enforced in code, not just documented.** "Per organization" is a deployment concept, so running this belongs to an operator. An export whose tables come back empty is reported `NOT_MEASURED` with the reason, never "zero implicit grants" — an empty dev database and a clean deployment are indistinguishable at the query. That is the failure shape #12775 is stuck on, and this generator cannot produce it.

## Measurable / not measurable

⚠️ **PM assumption 2 falsified: the census is NOT completable in-repo, and the report says so on every run.** Three gaps, printed in the census output itself:

1. Positions and permission sets created at **runtime** (Setup, admin UI) are invisible to any static scan.
2. Marketplace artifacts not vendored here. The in-repo HotCRM artifact carries that app's permission sets only — **its position roster is not in this repository**, so its 4 remaining sets are NOT MEASURED, not zero.
3. Per-organization state of any kind.

⛔ The in-repo sample is not passed off as the full population, and no fixture is presented as a production reading — the `sales_manager` control fires on real declarations, and the audit controls are labelled synthetic.

## Verification

Gate union re-derived from the actual diff and re-run at final head `fd6d70c`: 12 families, **11 green**, `check-test-completeness` **NOT MEASURED** (exit 3 `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` — it grades a saved turbo log CI supplies; not a red). Repo-level `pnpm lint` green (full run, not narrowed). `check:nul-bytes` green over 7543 files. Census self-test and audit rig green.

No changeset: root `scripts/` publishes nothing from any package (matching 11 recent scripts-only commits on `main`); `skip-changeset` applied.
